title: ornithopus sativus subvar. macrorrhynchus
intro: Ornithopus sativus subvar. macrorrhynchus, commonly known as White Clover, is a perennial legume plant native to Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, anxiety, and sleep disorders due to its health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anxiolytic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ornithopus sativus subvar. macrorrhynchus include sedation, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Additionally, studies have identified that the flavonoids present in White Clover possess cardiovascular protective effects, further solidifying its potential as a natural remedy.
